- Keyboard: the freeze in YTXTube's Google sign-in and in Game Hub's search is fixed (a web page's box in Pulse's own process is typed into without questions; they waited out their timeout and froze the screen, and could close the app); the floating keyboard's edge keys are no longer cut; after an "@" only the domains are offered, never whole saved addresses.
- Keyboard: hold 3 on the number pad for the password manager (search, a tap fills the user name or password the field asks for, a hold fills the other); tiny icons on 1, 2 and 3 show what holding them opens (clipboard, authenticator, passwords).
- Keyboard effects: every key-press effect sits in two rows that scroll together; four RGB effects (RGB halo, RGB edge, Rainbow, Pulse); effect colour (theme, cyan, pink, green or RGB, a new hue with every press) and effect length; fewer effects are drawn at once and Matrix is lighter, so typing no longer lags.
- YTXTube opens again (its player session clashed with the music player's, which crashed it on start). Settings > Apps lists YTXTube, has a search box and a redrawn Game Hub icon.
- Downloads: Series and movies is a page of its own (Back returns to the downloads); posters are fetched with timeouts, a browser identity and a smaller-size fallback.
- Music: the library shows in full as soon as the player is pulled down (it faded in over a long pull and stayed black), and every library page sits on a soft see-through plate.
- Windows 11 launcher: choose the glass of the taskbar and menus (Pulse, Darker, Less blur, Clear) in the launcher settings.
- Game Hub: the cover on the details page is whole and bigger. Full-screen player: swipe down to leave; picture-in-picture shows subtitles.
